start: A gym owner seeing the panel for the first time, not signed in, on the first screen

steps.action: Tap 'Start demo'
user_sees: A full gym named Iron Temple Fitness, Malviya Nagar, Jaipur opens
About 128 members with plans, payments and check-ins
must_not: A sign-up or a phone number asked first
An empty gym

steps.action: Open Members, Money and the renewals list
user_sees: Plans Monthly, Quarterly, Half-yearly, Annual and Day pass
Some members part-paid; renewals falling due around today
must_not: Every plan long expired because the dates are fixed in the past
Dates in the future for payments already taken

steps.action: Reload the page
user_sees: The same demo gym
must_not: A new, different gym after a reload
The demo gone

start: A gym owner on the first screen with no internet

steps.action: Tap the choice 'Open the demo without the shop. It works without internet.'
user_sees: The same made-up gym opens; pages that need the internet say they are switched off in the demo
must_not: An endless spinner
An error page because the shop could not be reached

start: A gym owner inside the demo gym

steps.action: Look for a way to put the demo gym online
user_sees: A card that says the members are made up and kept only in this browser, and that they can’t be put online; it points to 'Erase and start fresh'
must_not: The made-up members sent to the server
A sign-in code or a join code handed out for made-up data

steps.action: Add a member with a mobile number a demo member already has
user_sees: A plain message that the number is taken
must_not: Two members with one number

start: A gym owner who opened the demo gym yesterday

steps.action: Open the panel again today
user_sees: The demo gym as it was left, with what was added yesterday
must_not: The demo rebuilt over yesterday’s changes without asking

steps.action: Open Settings, tap 'Erase and start fresh', confirm 'Erase everything'
user_sees: Sheet 'Erase everything?' with 'You will be left with an empty gym: no members, no plans, no payments.'
Note 'Started fresh.'; an empty gym
must_not: Made-up members left behind
The demo card still shown for the empty gym

steps.action: Tap 'Load demo gym' again and confirm
user_sees: 'Demo gym loaded.'; the same names and plans as the first time, dated around today
must_not: A half-loaded gym
Two copies of every member

start: A gym owner showing the demo gym to someone else

steps.action: Open members and their phone numbers
user_sees: Made-up names and numbers
must_not: A real person’s name with their real number
Any of it leaving this browser

steps.action: Open Settings, Your data
user_sees: 'Saved in this browser only.' and 'A demo gym is never put online.'
must_not: The demo data found on another device or online

start: An owner of a gym kept in this browser only (not online), on Settings

steps.action: Tap 'Load demo gym'
user_sees: Sheet 'Load the demo gym?'
'This makes a sample gym with about 128 members, their payments and check-ins. Use it to show someone the app. Don’t use it on a gym with real members.'
Button 'Load demo gym'
must_not: The gym replaced before the owner confirms

steps.action: Tap 'Load demo gym' in the sheet
user_sees: Note 'Demo gym loaded.'
The gym is now Iron Temple Fitness with about 128 members
must_not: A mix of the old gym and the demo
The UPI boxes of the old gym left filled for the demo gym

start: An owner of a new gym with no plans yet, on the Plans page

steps.action: Tap the button that adds the starter plans
user_sees: Five plans appear: Monthly ₹1,200, Quarterly ₹3,000, Half-yearly ₹5,500, Annual ₹10,000 and Day pass ₹200; a ₹500 joining fee on the first three
must_not: Made-up members added with the plans
The gym’s id or name changed to the demo gym’s

steps.action: Tap the button twice, fast
user_sees: Five plans, once
must_not: Ten plans with the same names (plans can be retired, never deleted)

steps.action: The internet drops after the second plan (online gym)
user_sees: The reason, then 'Some plans may already be added. Check the list.'
must_not: A success message
The first two plans added again on the next try without a word

start: An owner of an ONLINE gym, on Settings

steps.action: Look for 'Load demo gym' and 'Erase and start fresh'
user_sees: Neither button is there
must_not: A way to fill an online gym with sample members
A way to wipe an online gym from this page

steps.action: An owner of a browser-only gym with real members taps Load demo gym
user_sees: The warning 'Don’t use it on a gym with real members.' before anything changes
must_not: Real members replaced with no warning and no way to say no

start: An owner who loaded the demo gym in a browser-only gym

steps.action: Open Settings
user_sees: A card saying the members are made up and kept only in this browser, and how to start the real gym
must_not: The 'Put your gym online' offer for a demo gym

steps.action: Tap 'Erase and start fresh', confirm
user_sees: 'Started fresh.'; an empty gym with the gym name kept
must_not: The welcome screen again as if the gym was never set up
Demo members left

steps.action: Add real members, then put the gym online
user_sees: The real gym goes online
must_not: Any made-up member going online with it

start: An owner with the demo gym loaded, on Settings, Your data

steps.action: Read the lines about where the demo is kept
user_sees: 'Saved in this browser only.'
'A demo gym is never put online.'
must_not: The demo members reaching the server, a backup or the member app
